width="768" height="1024"></div><div><p class="skb-kicker">Your private area</p><h2>A thatched hut just for you, facing the bay</h2><p>Each bungalow has its own private thatched roof: a natural stone platform with a parasol and sunbed, sheltered from the wind. The perfect place to relax after a session, read, or enjoy a massage.</p><ul class="skb-ticks"><li>Bungalow approximately 15m from the water</li><li>Direct access to the kite and wingfoil spot</li><li>Full board and open bar included</li></ul></div></div><div class="skb-split skb-rev"><div class="skb-split-img"><img data-lazyloaded="1" src="data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3d3dy53My5vcmcvMjAwMC9zdmciIHdpZHRoPSI3NjgiIGhlaWdodD0iNTEyIiB2aWV3Qm94PSIwIDAgNzY4IDUxMiI+PHJlY3Qgd2lkdGg9IjEwMCUiIGhlaWdodD0iMTAwJSIgc3R5bGU9ImZpbGw6I2NmZDRkYjtmaWxsLW9wYWNpdHk6IDAuMTsiLz48L3N2Zz4=" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-src="https://sakalava.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/bungalowmer-768x512.jpg" alt="Bungalow with hammock under the casuarina trees" width="768" height="512"></div><div><p class="skb-kicker">Absolute calm</p><h2>A boutique lodge on a human scale</h2><p>Sakalava Lodge is situated on a private 5-hectare natural estate, populated by wild birds and lemurs. No traffic, no engine noise: only birdsong and the sound of waves on the coral reef.</p><p>With only 10 bungalows, including 3 family bungalows, we intentionally maintain a small capacity to guarantee peace and quiet, exclusivity, and personalized service.
